Title: Create a File
Description: Create a new file named "welcome.txt" in your home directory.

Title: Edit File with echo
Description: Add the text "Hello Linux!" to the file "welcome.txt" using echo command.

Title: View File Content
Description: Display the contents of the "welcome.txt" file.

Title: Copy a File
Description: Copy the file "welcome.txt" to a new file named "copy.txt" in the same directory.

Title: Move a File
Description: Move "copy.txt" to a directory named "backup" (create the directory first if it doesn’t exist).

Title: Remove a File
Description: Delete the file "copy.txt" from the "backup" directory.

Title: List Files
Description: Show all files (including hidden ones) in your current directory.

Title: Create Directory
Description: Create a directory named "projects" inside your home directory.

Title: Navigate Directories
Description: Change directory to "projects".

Title: Check Current Directory
Description: Display the full path of your current working directory.

Title: Create Multiple Files
Description: Create three files named "a.txt"

Title: View Disk Usage
Description: Display disk space usage using the "df" command.

Title: Check Memory Usage
Description: Show memory usage using the "free" command.

Title: Display System Uptime
Description: Show how long the system has been running using the "uptime" command.

Title: Show Current Users
Description: Display the list of users currently logged into the system.

Title: Show Date and Time
Description: Display the current date and time.

Title: Set Permissions
Description: Give execute permission to the file "welcome.txt".

Title: View File Permissions
Description: Check the permissions of "welcome.txt".

Title: Create Hidden File
Description: Create a hidden file named ".secret" in your home directory.

Title: Display File Type
Description: Use the "file" command to display the type of "welcome.txt".

Title: Create a Symbolic Link
Description: Create a symbolic link named "link_to_welcome" pointing to "welcome.txt".

Title: Count Words in File
Description: Count the number of words in "welcome.txt" using the "wc" command.

Title: Sort File Content
Description: Create a file "names.txt" with random names and sort them alphabetically.

Title: Search Inside File
Description: Find the word "Linux" in "welcome.txt" using "grep".

Title: Redirect Output
Description: Redirect the output of "ls" command to a file named "list.txt".

Title: Append Output
Description: Append the output of "pwd" command to "list.txt".

Title: Create User (Simulation)
Description: Simulate creating a new user named "student" using the "useradd" command.

Title: Switch User (Simulation)
Description: Simulate switching to the "student" user using the "su" command.

Title: Display System Info
Description: Show system information using the "uname -a" command.

Title: Show Running Processes
Description: Display the list of currently running processes.

Title: Kill a Process (Simulation)
Description: Simulate killing a process with PID 1234 using "kill" command.

Title: Check File Size
Description: Display the size of "welcome.txt" in bytes.

Title: Compress File
Description: Create a tar archive named "backup.tar" for your "projects" directory.

Title: Extract Archive
Description: Extract the contents of "backup.tar".

Title: View Command History
Description: Show the last 10 commands you executed.

Title: Check Network Info
Description: Display your system’s IP address using the "ip a" command.

Title: Ping a Website
Description: Simulate pinging "google.com" to test connectivity.

Title: Create an Empty File
Description: Create an empty file named "notes.txt" using "touch".

Title: Display File Lines
Description: Show only the first 5 lines of "names.txt".

Title: Display Last Lines
Description: Show the last 3 lines of "names.txt".

Title: Use Pipe Command
Description: Combine "ls" and "grep" to search for ".txt" files in your directory.

Title: Find a File
Description: Find a file named "welcome.txt" starting from your home directory.

Title: Check System Date Format
Description: Display the system date in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.

Title: Create Group (Simulation)
Description: Simulate creating a new group named "developers".

Title: Add User to Group (Simulation)
Description: Simulate adding "student" user to the "developers" group.

Title: Change File Ownership (Simulation)
Description: Simulate changing ownership of "welcome.txt" to "student".

Title: View Current User
Description: Show your current logged-in username.

Title: Set Alias
Description: Create an alias named "ll" for "ls -l".
